comparison_model: For bow forms defined in I2.3.1(v), take f_ai = min(f_ai1, f_ai2, f_ai3), where f_ai1 = (0.097 - 0.68*(x/L_UI - 0.15)^2)*alpha_i/(beta_i_prime)^0.5, f_ai2 = 1.2*C_FF/(sin(beta_i_prime)*C_FC*D_UI^0.64), and f_ai3 = 0.60.
source_basis: IACS UR I2.3.2.1(iii)(a): for I2.3.1(v) bow forms, fai=min(fai1,fai2,fai3). R13 marks formulaExecutionRequired=false, so Pilot 02 checks readiness structure only.
